name: narcoscope
description: Inspect public evidence about informal economies, drug and arms markets and regional context, with dataset provenance, units and source dates. Query the illicit-economy atlas and granular market observations from official sources such as wastewater monitoring, read privacy-minimized OFAC designation identities, and follow China, Belt and Road and corridor context from Palimpsest beside Seiche funding context as separate evidence lanes. NarcoScope supports research briefs and evidence checks; administrative counts do not establish market size, individual guilt or current operational activity. Access and publication restrictions remain visible.
